methodology.rawOnchainFormula: borrowInterest = (borrowIndexEnd - borrowIndexStart) * borrowParStart / 1e18; protocolRevenue = borrowInterest * (1 - earningsRate)
methodology.window: Each DeFiLlama row date is audited as that named UTC day, from 00:00 UTC on the date to 00:00 UTC the next day.
methodology.usdPricing: Raw token amounts are independently replayed from DolomiteMargin; USD totals use historical token prices and should be compared with tolerance.
methodology.immaterialMissingPricePolicy: Only explicitly allowlisted legacy/dust tokens below strict protocol-revenue amount caps may be priced as 0 USD; this keeps the chain audited but forces WARN.
methodology.immaterialMissingChainPolicy: DeFiLlama-missing chain rows are informational when independent onchain totals are below $1 revenue and $5 fees.
methodology.immaterialDustScalePolicy: When both DeFiLlama and onchain daily totals are below $5 fees and $1 revenue, relative diffs are informational because DeFiLlama rounds chain rows to whole USD.
methodology.archiveRpcRequirement: Historical eth_call requires archive-capable RPC. Chains without archive access are marked missing, not pass.
